seen.excerpt: 06-09-2026 : « quand plusieurs Q portent la même écriture, le script ne choisit pas — il marque ambigu » ; « un objet russe peut être rattaché au mauvais Q par homographie ».

prevention.note: choosing between several items that carry the same writing needs the sense of the sentence; the script flags ambiguous, which is honest, but the choice itself is out of reach of code

repair.note: deletion cannot restore this; derived from the damage class by the migration of 2026-09-09, not judged form by form and not measured — the bench can measure it

measured.source: measured 2026-09-10 by pgrepair (SciPyWeightedILP) on the frozen EUR-Lex truth, three identical runs, journal sha256 in measures/reachability-by-damage-2026-09-10.json. Per damage class, not per form: two forms of the same damage and the same visibility get the same answer.

obstacle.reason: Two entities fused into one are separated by SPLITTING, which means deciding which fact belongs to whom. Deletion can only remove the fused node and everything hanging from it.
obstacle.reason_fr: Deux entités fondues en une se séparent en les SCINDANT, ce qui veut dire décider quel fait appartient à qui. La suppression ne peut que retirer le nœud fondu et tout ce qui y pend.
obstacle.source: derived from what a deletion-only repair can express, read in the repairer's own code — its solution is a set of elements to delete and carries no insertion — together with the measurement of 2026-09-10. Per damage class, not per form.
